shader_exit.screen.title: ShaderExit
shader_exit.screen.subtitle: Choose which mods bypass the shader pack
shader_exit.screen.toggle_hint: Changes are saved immediately. OFF keeps the mod's original rendering.
shader_exit.screen.saved_hint: Changes apply immediately and are saved automatically.
shader_exit.screen.save_failed: Could not save settings. Check the log; the change was not applied.
shader_exit.mod.minihud: World overlays rendered through MaLiLib, such as shapes and boundaries.
shader_exit.mod.litematica: MaLiLib world overlay callbacks only. Schematic terrain rendering is not covered.
shader_exit.mod.malilib: Other MaLiLib world renderers. Does not override the individual choices above.
shader_exit.mod.minecraft: Vanilla world debug renderers and gizmos.
shader_exit.mod.carpet: Shape rendering for both Carpet itself and Carpet TIS Addition, including scarpet shapes and micro-timing markers.
